item.title: Self-Hosted Linux Temp File Management: systemd-tmpfiles vs tmpwatch vs tmpreaper (2026)
item.description: Every Linux server accumulates temporary files: application caches, session data, crash reports, package manager downloads, and log archives. Without automated cleanup, /tmp and /var/tmp fill up, causing service failures, login issues, and system instability.
